visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair tied back, wearing a maroon short-sleeved shirt and black pants, is crouching on a light beige tiled floor. She holds a white ceramic plate containing several large, steamed green broccoli florets. Two Corgi dogs, one primarily white and the other tan and white, are positioned closely around her, looking expectantly at the food. In the background, there are multiple plastic shopping bags filled with various items and a few cardboard boxes stacked against the wall. (2) The woman uses her right hand to break off a small portion of broccoli from the plate and offers it to the white and tan Corgi on the right. The dog takes it gently from her hand. The camera zooms in slightly, focusing on the dog's face as it chews. A small, stray piece of broccoli is visible on the tile floor near the dogs. The lighting is bright and direct, suggesting an indoor domestic setting. (3) The woman continues the feeding process, moving her hand back to the plate to gather more broccoli. The second Corgi, seen partially from the back, waits its turn. The woman's movements are steady and patient. The cluttered background of household storage remains visible, including a box labeled with shipping information. The camera remains handheld, with slight tremors indicating a live recording of the pet-feeding interaction.
